title: Session 8: Feed Me, Igor: Grounding Your Agent in Real Data
description: Igor is alive but currently a compulsive liar. This session we ground him in FrankenForce's real product data, so he stops guessing and starts telling the truth — a core Agentforce concept for anyone building agents. Jump in even if you missed Session 7.

title: Session 9: From Dusty Old Rules to Agent Actions
description: FrankenForce's Seam-Split Exchange Guarantee is buried in an ancient Flow nobody understands. This session we rebuild it as a real, invocable Agentforce Action, live. If your org has similar legacy logic, the pattern translates directly.

title: Session 10: Trust No Monster: Zero-Trust Permissions for Renfield
description: Should an AI agent unilaterally refund a $500 order? Renfield currently thinks yes — we disagree. This session we build zero-trust permission boundaries for autonomous agents: what they can decide alone vs. what needs a human sign-off.
